title: The Witt filtration of Lubin-Tate deformation rings
summary: This note is a meditation on a generalization $\mathbb{W}_E$ of the classical p-typical Witt vectors $\mathbb{W}_p$, which arises (geometrically) from isogenies of deformations of formal groups, or (topologically) from the theory of power operations on Morava $E$-theory. For formal groups of height $1$ we have $\mathbb{W}_E=\mathbb{W}_p$, but the $\mathbb{W}_E$ are richer when height is $\geq 2$. We show that $\mathbb{W}_p$ splits naturally from $\mathbb{W}_E$.
